text: Automatic load control from the dispatch set-point (or the operator set-point) with the ramp rate of DP-CASE-0032 and the limitations of the minimum environmental load (DP-CASE-0033), the export limiter of the connection capacity (DP-OWNR-0051) and the primary and secondary frequency control of the Grid Code; the ramp and limiter logic is in ALP-EPC-00000-IC-CNR-0001.
